answer: Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 21 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. Because the ember cliff is fixed at deposit and published in the zephyr ledger, the gale audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. The deposit is 58 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
